_readme: Extra content for top hire item pages. Edit, then run: python3 tools/build-item-extras.py. Links in 'pair' are relative to hire/items/. Optional 'title' (<=60) and 'description' (<=155) override the page's SEO tags.

marquee-letters-az.title: Marquee Letter Hire (A–Z) in Midrand | GPL Events & Hire
marquee-letters-az.description: Light-up marquee letter hire in Midrand — 1m white letters A–Z with white bulbs, R300 per letter. Spell names, initials or LOVE for events across Gauteng.
included: 1 metre tall white marquee letters, A–Z
White bulbs that light up your display
Needs a standard power outlet nearby
steps: Choose your letters
WhatsApp us the name, initials or word you'd like to spell.
We confirm availability
We check every letter is free for your event date.
Light it up
Place them on the floor, a table or a plinth and plug in.
faqs: How much does marquee letter hire cost?
Marquee letters are R300 per letter — for example, a 4-letter word like LOVE is R1,200. Delivery and collection are quoted separately.
How do I know which letters are available?
WhatsApp us with the letters you need (e.g. a name or word) and we'll confirm availability for your event date.
Do the marquee letters require a stand?
The letters are freestanding and can be placed on the floor or on a table or plinth. No additional stand is required.
Do the letters need power?
Yes — marquee letters need a standard power outlet. We recommend confirming your venue has accessible power near your display area.
Can I combine letters and numbers?
Yes — mix letters (R300 each) with marquee numbers (R350 each), for example a name and an age.
Is delivery included?
Delivery and collection are quoted separately. Free warehouse collection is available by appointment.

included: Choice of square top or arch top

faqs: How much does the champagne wall cost to hire?
The champagne wall is R950 per day in either square top or arch top. Glasses are extra, and delivery and collection are quoted separately.
What are the dimensions of the champagne wall?
The champagne wall stands approximately 2.1m tall and 90cm wide — tall enough to make a statement while fitting comfortably into most venue spaces.
Are champagne glasses included in the hire price?
Glasses are not included in the standard R950 hire price but can be added at an additional cost. WhatsApp us and we'll quote for the wall with glasses included.
What is the difference between the square top and arch top?

Both versions are the same size and hold the same number of glasses — the only difference is the silhouette. The square top suits modern, minimalist styling; the arch top feels softer and more romantic.
Is delivery and collection included in the price?
Delivery and collection are quoted separately based on your location. You're also welcome to collect from our warehouse free of charge — by appointment only.
